messages:
Devon (Design): quick thread re: Pools bulk-delete UX. Two things: 1) how to surface failures when some rows error (inline per-row vs single top summary), 2) typed-confirm copy + keyboard behavior for destructive deletes. Priya (PM): i'm leaning summary-first for bulk ops. folks expect a single place to check results. link out to rows for deep context. :white_check_mark: Noah (Eng): summary + anchors sounds OK. implementation note: set focus to summary after submit and make anchors expand the row detail without reloading. avoid focus thrash. Ruth (DevEx): also recommend inline collapsed previews for the first 2 failures so people can see the error message without jumping. keep them collapsed by default for large lists. Devon (Design): for screen readers, should we announce "X failed" and then allow the user to navigate? any aria examples? a11y-bot: recommended approach: move focus to a status container with role="status" and aria-live="polite" announcing the failure count. Provide links with aria-controls that toggle hidden regions. Example snippet: ```
4 items failed
  • Row 42: View
Permission denied: delete_pool
``` Noah (Eng): nice. also ensure the browser's focus is set to #bulk-status so keyboard users land there. include a skip link back to the selection grid. Devon (Design): typed-confirm debate: exact typed name vs a required checkbox + extra warning. thoughts on where to land? Priya (PM): typed name is safest for org-owned or high-impact pools; checkbox is OK for personal/small ones. maybe make it a rule: typed-confirm if >20 members or org-owned. Ruth (DevEx): if we do typed-confirm, autofocus input and disable the confirm CTA until it matches. show inline validation (match / mismatch). ESC should close modal and restore focus to the trigger. Noah (Eng): technical: trim whitespace, compare case-sensitively? i'd prefer trim + exact match but case-insensitive might reduce friction but is less strict. decision needed. Devon (Design): copy suggestion: instead of "Type the pool name to confirm" use "Enter the pool name to permanently delete this pool." emphasize permanent. a11y-bot: accessibility checklist for typed-confirm: set autocomplete="off", use aria-invalid when mismatch, point aria-describedby to helper/error text, and ensure the error message is programmatically visible. Announce success/failure in the same aria-live region or a new one. Priya (PM): decision call: hybrid error surface (top summary with aria-live + anchors) + collapsed inline preview for first 2 fails. Typed-confirm: opt-in for org-owned / >20 members; if enabled, autofocus input, disable CTA until trimmed exact match, allow paste. copy to use "permanently delete" phrasing. Ruth (DevEx): i'll add keyboard/focus acceptance criteria to the PR checklist and a small test plan. Noah (Eng): i'll add the focus-management tickets and the exact-match rule (trim, case-sensitive?). proposal: trimmed, case-sensitive to preserve exactness. Devon (Design): i'll post mocks for the summary-first pattern + typed-confirm modal with the copy tweak. tagging @Noah @Ruth @Priya for review. Priya (PM): thanks, will update the spec and rollout guidance. Noah (Eng): ack, will review mocks.
